# Continue pagination for unread outbox threads
all_threads = []
page_limit = 20  # within allowed range; use larger than default to reduce pages
page_index = 0
while True:
    page = apis.gmail.show_outbox_threads(access_token=gmail_token, read=False, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    print('page', page_index, 'len', len(page))
    if not page:
        break
    all_threads.extend(page)
    page_index += 1

print('total_threads', len(all_threads))
# Verification: ensure all have read==False
print('any_read_true', any(t.get('read') for t in all_threads))
print('sample_ids', [t['email_thread_id'] for t in all_threads[:5]])
